description: The article recommends that institutions use machine learning predictions of withdrawal risk to trigger timely, personalized support (academic guidance, financial assistance, mentorship) before students leave.
title: Deploy ML-based early-warning prediction to shift retention support from reactive to proactive intervention

description: The article's implementable recipe is to let a machine learning algorithm determine which questions to include in a learner's study sessions over time, while leaving review timing to the learner.
title: Sequence practice items with an ML algorithm that prioritizes questions by predicted recall probability rather than fixing the rate of study

title: Design m-learning apps for offline access, cross-device synchronization, context-awareness, personalized paths, and responsive support services

description: To address curriculum saturation and limited protected curricular time, the review reports recommendations to offer MLM training as elective modules or student-selected components.
title: Offer MLM training as elective modules or student-selected components to ease curriculum overcrowding

title: Integrate MLM education longitudinally with experiential learning and robust program evaluation
